先输入一个 arXiv 链接或 ID: Enter an arXiv link or ID first
请先选择 LaTeX 源码文件: Choose a LaTeX source file first
任务已开始，可在下方查看进度: Task started. Follow its progress below.
文件超过 80 MB，请精简源码包后重试: File exceeds 80 MB. Reduce the source archive and try again.
请选择 .tex 或 LaTeX 源码压缩包: Choose a .tex file or a LaTeX source archive
无法连接本地服务。请运行 texglot --serve，页面会自动重连。: Cannot connect to the local service. Run texglot --serve to reconnect automatically.
导入 arXiv 链接或 LaTeX 源码，生成翻译后的 PDF。: Turn an arXiv link or LaTeX source into a translated PDF.
支持论文链接、PDF 链接和 arXiv ID。: Accepts paper links, PDF links, and arXiv IDs.
多文件工程请连同图片、参考文献和模板一起打包。: Include figures, references, and templates in multi-file archives.
文件与任务保存在本机: Files and tasks stay on this device
还需要安装编译器。macOS：brew install tectonic: Install a compiler first. On macOS: brew install tectonic
连接你的模型 API 后，即可开始翻译。: Connect your model API to start translating.
查看翻译记录，阅读和下载论文。: Browse your translations. Read and download papers.
完成的论文会显示在这里。: Your translated papers will appear here.
翻译 Attention Is All You Need: Translate Attention Is All You Need
配置模型服务、API 密钥和翻译偏好。: Configure your provider, API key, and translation preferences.
填写接口根地址，可包含 /v1，不需要 /chat/completions。: Use the API base URL, including /v1 if needed, without /chat/completions.
已安全保存在本机 · 留空保留: Saved locally · Leave blank to keep
已配置，填写可替换: Configured; enter a new key to replace
attention = 注意力\nembedding = 嵌入\n保留 Tran:
attention = 注意力
embedding = 嵌入
Keep Transformer untranslated
每行一条术语偏好，用于保持整篇论文的译法一致。: One term preference per line, applied throughout the paper.
密钥只保存至本机服务，不会写入前端或导出文件。翻译段落会发送至你配置的模型服务。: Your key is stored only by the local service, never in the browser or exports. Text is sent to your configured model provider for translation.
PDF 加载失败，可下载后用系统阅读器打开: Could not load PDF. Download it to open in your system viewer.
页面渲染失败，请下载 PDF 查看: Could not render this page. Download the PDF to view it.
在新标签页打开 PDF: Open PDF in a new tab
译文与原文可能因语言长度产生分页差异；对照按页码同步。: Pagination may differ between languages. Views sync by page number.
输入格式不正确，请检查后重试: Invalid input. Please check and try again.
阅读位置尚未保存，请检查本地连接: Reading position has not been saved. Check the local connection.
仅保存在 TeXGlot，不写入 PDF: Saved in TeXGlot only, never in the PDF
选中文字添加高亮或下划线，也可以使用便签工具点击页面。: Select text to highlight or underline. Use the sticky note tool to leave a note anywhere on a page.
此批注属于较早的 PDF 版本，内容已保留。: This annotation belongs to an earlier PDF version. Its contents are preserved.
点击页面添加便签: Click a page to add a sticky note
选中文字后自动添加标记: Select text to mark it automatically
按文档进度同步，原译文分页可能不同: Sync by document progress; pagination may differ
连续滚动阅读 · 阅读位置自动保存: Continuous scrolling · Reading position saved automatically
草稿已恢复，请检查批注的最新版本后保存。: Draft restored. Check the latest annotation before saving.
按页码与页内位置同步: Sync by page and position within page
本次翻译结合论文摘要理解主题与术语。: Use the paper abstract to understand the topic and terminology.
本次翻译仅处理当前段落，不附加论文摘要。: Translate each paragraph without adding abstract context.
作为新任务的默认设置，不会更改已有任务。: Default for new tasks. Existing tasks keep their own setting.
此任务正在使用的翻译方式。: Translation mode used by this running task.
下次重新处理或继续任务时生效。: Applies when you next reprocess or resume this task.
开启后，使用论文原文摘要作为背景，帮助理解研究主题与术语。关闭后，只翻译当前段落: When enabled, the original abstract provides context for the topic and terminology. When disabled, each paragraph is translated without abstract context.
默认关闭深度思考，减少翻译等待与额外输出。: Thinking is disabled by default to reduce waiting and extra output.
从百炼 API Key 页面复制 OpenAI 兼容地址，须与密钥的业务空间和地: Copy the OpenAI-compatible URL from the Bailian API Key page. It must match the key’s workspace and region.
留空保留，填写可替换: Leave blank to keep the saved key
请填写百炼控制台提供的 OpenAI 兼容地址: Enter the OpenAI-compatible URL from the Bailian console
未安装 LaTeX 编译器。请运行项目安装脚本，或安装 Tectonic / T: No LaTeX compiler found. Run the project setup script or install Tectonic / TeX Live, then retry.
源码包包含 Windows 不支持的文件名，请修改文件名及对应引用: The source contains filenames unsupported by Windows. Rename them and update the corresponding references.
源码包有重复或仅大小写不同的文件名，Windows 无法区分: The source contains duplicate or case-only filenames that Windows cannot distinguish.
检查 TeXGlot 的最新正式版本。: Check for the latest stable release of TeXGlot.
下载后打开安装包，将 TeXGlot 拖入 Applications 并确认替换: After downloading, open the installer, drag TeXGlot into Applications and confirm replacement. Your papers, settings and annotations are kept.
下载后打开安装程序完成更新。论文、设置和批注会保留。: After downloading, open the installer to complete the update. Your papers, settings and annotations are kept.
此版本暂未提供适合本机的可验证安装包，请查看版本说明。: A verifiable installer for this computer is not available yet. Please see the release notes.
下载期间可以继续使用 TeXGlot。: You can keep using TeXGlot while the update downloads.
更新服务暂时限流，请稍后再试。: The update service is rate-limiting requests. Please try again later.
暂时无法检查更新，请检查网络后重试。: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
更新下载中断，请检查网络后重新下载。: The update download was interrupted. Check your connection and download again.
安装包校验未通过，请重新下载。: Installer verification failed. Please download it again.
未能打开安装包，请稍后重试。: Could not open the installer. Please try again.
仍有论文正在处理。请等待完成或停止任务后再安装。: Papers are still being processed. Wait for them to finish or stop the tasks before installing.
暂时无法确认任务状态，请恢复本地连接后再安装。: Could not confirm the task status. Restore the local connection before installing.
暂时无法连接桌面更新服务，请重新打开应用。: Could not reach the desktop update service. Please reopen the app.
请先保存或处理尚未保存的批注，再安装更新。: Please save or resolve pending annotations before installing the update.
